propositions: The completion verifier pins a stale ticket snapshot from the local refs/heads/tickets mirror instead of the live tracker HEAD, causing it to read outdated ticket state and produce false verdicts.
The close path calls materialize_tickets with fetch=False, which skips fetching from origin/tickets and pins an arbitrarily stale local branch that may lag the live store by thousands of commits.

The verifier's fenced context comes from the live store while show_ticket reads from the pinned snapshot, causing the two halves of the gate to disagree on ticket state and producing false unmet criteria.
A non-PASS verdict with no identifiable findings is coerced to FAIL with a synthesized placeholder criterion (unspecified) instead of reporting a verifier fault.

Two independently-blocked closes failed with different symptoms (stale comments and budget starvation) traced to the same root cause of reading a stale pinned snapshot that lacked essential ticket events.
